name: Billing Service Adjustment 1
definition: Specifies the billing adjustments for a specific service.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Free-form description and clarification of the adjustment.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of the adjustment, expressed in the settlement currency.||Usage: If the amount would reduce charges due then the amount should be negatively signed.

BalanceRequiredAmount.name: Balance Required Amount
BalanceRequiredAmount.definition: Specifies whether the balance amount requires an adjustment.

ErrorDate.name: Error Date
ErrorDate.definition: Date on which the situation causing the service adjustment occurred. If the date is not known then used the last day of the month in which the situation occurred or the date of the billing statement which reported the original service to which this adjustment applies.

AdjustmentIdentification.name: Adjustment Identification
AdjustmentIdentification.definition: Financial institution's own, internal service identification code, used to uniquely identify the service within the financial institution.

SubService.name: Sub Service
SubService.definition: Defines the financial institution sub-service identification if the financial institution service identification code is used for more than one service.

PriceChange.name: Price Change
PriceChange.definition: Change in the service price, expressed in the pricing currency. A negative value indicates a price reduction.

OriginalPrice.name: Original Price
OriginalPrice.definition: Price that was applied to the service, prior to the change, expressed in the pricing currency.

NewPrice.name: New Price
NewPrice.definition: New, adjusted service price, expressed in the pricing currency.

VolumeChange.name: Volume Change
VolumeChange.definition: Change in the service volume. A negative value indicates a volume reduction.

OriginalChargeAmount.name: Original Charge Amount
OriginalChargeAmount.definition: Service charge that was applied to the service, prior to the change, expressed in the pricing currency.

NewChargeAmount.name: New Charge Amount
NewChargeAmount.definition: New, adjusted service charge, expressed in the pricing currency.
